product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides low-latency speech models, APIs and voice agents for enterprises automating support, sales, collections and scheduling.

pricing_page.notes: Public voice-agent pricing page includes free credits and pay-as-you-go pricing.

employee_band.notes: An August 2026 announcement reported nearly 60 employees; this is not a live headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Includes hardware/inference co-optimization by an inference engineer and streaming-model evaluation by the company's TTS research-and-development team.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers voice agents, speech and language models, SDKs and API references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Speech Research Scientist — Bangalore; the posting provides an application link.

model_provider.value: Smallest AI's in-house Lightning, Pulse, Electron and Hydra models; OpenAI models including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT Realtime and GPT Realtime Mini.
model_provider.notes: The voice-agent documentation lists both Smallest AI and OpenAI model options.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly claims compliance with these standards; specifies SOC 2 Type II.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 30, 2026, led by Seligman Ventures; $21 million-plus refers to cumulative funding, not this round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A announced July 30, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Recent posting for Business Development Representative (BDR) — GTM & Outbound — US.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 5, 2026 Lightning V3 announcement states that the model is available on its pay-as-you-go plan.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No explicitly qualifying C-level or VP-level change could be verified, and a complete dated leadership history was unavailable.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting explicitly lists Zoho as its CRM and the other three as sales tools.
